svg.title: One config, four agent engines
svg.desc: agent.type in workflow.yml selects one of four engines: native (built in), react (LangChain), llamaindex or openai-agents. All four talk to the same OVMS server with the same model, tools and endpoint.

g.text: agent.type is the one line that picks the engine. Tools and prompt stay as they are.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: native: OVAT's own loop. It needs nothing extra.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
